vehicle.scope: Actual final-build WebGL views with full materials and shadows; front-lamp state export is independent, not a synchronized screenshot-condition pair. Numerical boundary/ray tests provide the exact seam checks.

scope.conditions: High quality 1280x720, same 180 s input record; physical dry road for both visual presets. Capture windows start at slightly different route steps due to UI operations. 5 s active warmup plus 150 s capture. Driver/shader caches may be warm from earlier inspection and preparation; no cold-start or controlled before/after speedup claim.
scope.concurrency: No numerical tests, build jobs, other benchmark or vehicle-inspection rendering during either capture. Occasional browser AX observations and screenshots, light file/document work and this chat remained active. Not an exclusive OS benchmark.
scope.limits: All observed long frames are retained. Shader readiness covers submitted programs, not every possible future draw. Preparation can be slow after configuration changes. This single RTX 4080 SUPER device does not certify lower-end/mobile performance, hardware keyboard/gamepad input, or subjective audio quality. localStorage remains limited to 4 MiB; session-only results must be exported. A shared full-city route is not coverage of every district.
scope.visual: day-route.png and night-route.png are actual moving screenshots at different route locations, not pixel-matched before/after pairs. City geometry and quality budgets are retained; no new-district claim.

gpuMatrix.scope: Product UI switching matrix: 14 actual PNGs and same-frame conditions across high/ultra/balanced day/night cases. Diagnostic runs after, separately from both performance captures. It is a drawing-integrity check, not a driving performance benchmark. First-time variants caused long UI/driver waits; all cases completed and original physics/presentation restored.
